text:
Maya: Quick kickoff  SF Dev Meetup confirmed for Jun 3. We have a 10-min demo window + tabletop. Need owners: talk submission, demo script, table logistics, swag shipping, and lead capture routing. Shipping cutoff May 27. Who can take talk submission by tomorrow?

Vikram: I can put together the talk. Will compress our latency/cost story into a 7-slide flow + short demo script. Any constraints on sample code in the slide?

Sophia: Keep code snippets to 2 lines max for the slide. For the leave-behind one-pager, I'll draft a micro-benchmark and 3 integration tips. Deadline May 20 works for me.

Noah: I'll coordinate swag. Proposal: 250 stickers, 120 postcards, 80 branded socks (we're low on novelty). Vendor: bundle-swag.com. PO PO-5901. ETA May 30. Note: socks cost pushed us ~$400 over target. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Tia: We can trim postcards to 80 to hit budget. If agreed, I'll finalize order. Also confirm shipping address and contact for onsite hold.

Eli: AV + demo table here. Need HDMI dongle, small 15\" monitor, battery pack, 2 clip mics, and extension cord. I can be onsite contact for receiving and lead follow-up.

Maya: Good tradeoff on postcards. Decision: stickers 250, postcards 80, socks 80. Tia please finalize. Lead capture: we'll use QR -> short Airtable form + badge scanner fallback. Routing: Airtable webhook -> HubSpot list "SF Dev Meetup" -> assign to Noah for 48h -> then SDR queue. Noah can you own the Airtable form and Zapier mapping?

Noah: On it. Will make form short: name, company, email, use-case checkbox (integrations/throughput/cost/benchmarks), interested in demo (y/n). Zap: airtable.record_created -> POST to HubSpot API with utm params.

Vikram: Can you include utm_source=sf_dev_meetup&utm_campaign=jun3_demo on all links and the QR? Also I'll need the latest perf charts for the demo - tail latency + tokens.

labs-bot: Perf upload complete: https://drive.re/redwood/bench/june3_devmeet_tail.png

Sophia: For the one-pager, please confirm the target audience (platform engineers vs product engineers). I can tailor language.

Maya: Target: platform & infra engineers. Keep recommendations practical (3 bullets with an example call). Example snippet should show batching + cache wins.

Eli: Shipping contact? I'll be on-site but need the courier name and tracking to present to venue. Also want a simple table layout: monitor center, postcards left, stickers on top-right, swag bags under table.

Tia: Shipping via QuickHold Logistics. Contact: Priya (priya@quickhold.io). Tracking QH987654321. I'll add hold-for-pickup notes and put "Maya / Redwood Inference" as recipient.

Maya: Dry run scheduled Jun 1 @ 11am PT. Please bring slide deck + demo script. Post-run we'll create a 1-page runbook and an arrival checklist. Also reminder: speaker submission form closed May 10, but since we have a slot I'm submitting as an organizer talk. Vikram please file the short bio + headshot.

Vikram: Uploaded bio + headshot to the shared drive. Added UTM to demo link: https://demo.redwood.ai/play?utm_source=sf_dev_meetup&utm_campaign=jun3_demo

Noah: Zapier mapping drafted:
```
trigger: airtable_new_record
action: POST https://api.hubspot.com/contacts/v1/contact
payload: {"properties":[{"property":"email","value":"{{email}}"},{"property":"utm_source","value":"sf_dev_meetup"},{"property":"owner","value":"Noah"}]}
```
I'll test with a sandbox entry and confirm by May 22.

Sophia: Final note on handout: I'll include a small chart (baseline 2-token vs 1k-token tail) and a 3-step integration checklist. Expect draft May 18.

Maya: Great. Recap owners: Vikram = talk + demo link + bio, Sophia = one-pager + handout, Tia = swag order & shipping, Noah = leads form + zap, Eli = AV + onsite. I'll ping each with calendar invites and attach the runbook template. :rocket:
